title: Starlight Theatre (Kansas City, Missouri)
geometryBasis: Mapped stage house and amphitheatre outlines, locked 2022 USDA ortho, USGS terrain and the exact public-domain Qualla stage photograph.
sectionBasis: The operator describes a ten-storey stage house opened in 2000 and distinguishes the 1950 and 2000 flanking towers. The Qualla reference establishes the relative tower heights, pale rolling door, gridded lighting deck and flared roofs.
limitations: The exterior depicts the open-air layout evidenced in 2008 and 2022. Later light-bridge towers and canopy work are outside this historical configuration.
The outline, footprint and grading are mapped. Roof heights, brick and steel detailing, individual seats and auxiliary facilities are approximated at medium fidelity.
